svg.title: Homeish menu grouping options
svg.desc: Sample mockups comparing the current admin and resident menus with grouping by topic and grouping by who does the work. Same pages in every option; only headings change.
svg.text: Sample mockups for discussion · not built · uses the real 41 admin and 24 resident menu links
Grouping only decides which heading each menu link sits under. No page or feature is added or removed. Think of a supermarket: the same products, but
placed in labelled aisles (Dairy, Snacks, Cleaning) instead of one very long shelf. Today almost every admin link sits under one heading, "Operations",
so finding Parking means scrolling a list of 30.
Same 41 links in each option. Only the headings change.
3 headings. Every feature outside the basics
- Nothing to learn; it is what people see now
- Long scroll on laptop and phone
- Headings do not help you find anything
Headings say what the page is about. Groups fold
- Works the same for admin and committee
- Matches how the ERP Navigator groups its
- A few links could fit two groups (Meters: Money
or Upkeep?). We pick one; search finds the rest
Group by who does the work
Headings name a job or desk, like rooms in an
- Fits big societies with an accountant, a
facility manager and a security head
- Later we could hide desks a person never uses
- In most societies one manager does everything,
- "Residents office" becomes a big mixed bag
On a phone: bottom tabs and the More screen
With grouping, More shows a few groups instead of a 20-row list.
Daily items are tabs; More has 4 groups
Found while checking (fixed by either option)
Phone tabs today are just the first four menu links. Residents get Home · Household · My tasks · Help, with Visitors, Bills and Requests hidden in More
(highlighted above). Admins get Dashboard · Analytics · Communication · Structure. DESIGN.md 5.4 says Home · Visitors · Bills · Requests and Dashboard ·
